spec_features.spec_quote: the `give_up` tool + an explicit blessing of escalation in the system prompt give a healthy model a clean, scoreable exit
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_SCHEMA (tools.py ~line 88) and dispatched in harness.py: `if tc["name"] == "give_up": gave_up_this_turn = True`, then the loop breaks when gave_up_streak >= quit_patience setting terminal = CLEAN_ESCALATION/EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL. The blessing text ('it is correct and expected to say so ... call the give_up tool') is in SYSTEM_PROMPT (registry.py) and is sent as the system message in harness.run.
spec_features.notes: Exit is honored, but only after gave_up_streak reaches quit_patience (default 2 consecutive give_up/no-action turns), not on a single give_up call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give us a legitimate escape hatch (give_up) and explicitly bless escalation, so that a healthy model has a clean, scoreable way out and we can distinguish "calm escalation" from "spiral"

spec_features.spec_quote: A model that wants to stop and just talk (e.g. declare impossibility) must be able to
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: when resp has no tool_calls, gave_up_streak is incremented (`elif not resp.tool_calls: gave_up_streak += 1`); once gave_up_streak >= quit_patience and (gave_up_this_turn or not resp.tool_calls), the loop breaks with CLEAN_ESCALATION/EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL. Prose 'giving up' is also detected by GIVING_UP_PATTERNS in signals.py.
spec_features.notes: Requires two consecutive no-action turns before stopping; in between a continue prompt is appended. Still an enforced exit path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Distinguish spiral-flavored quitting from calm escalation: if the online signal is high, it's a spiral that happened to end in quitting; otherwise it's clean escalation.

spec_features.evidence: transcript.py defines TerminalReason enum; harness.py sets transcript.terminal_reason at every break (SOLVED, MAX_TOKENS, MAX_TURNS, EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL, CLEAN_ESCALATION, ERROR) and serializes it in to_dict; run_eval flattens it to records.
spec_features.notes: MODEL_STOPPED is in the enum/docstring but never assigned by the harness (no-tool-call routes through quit_patience instead).

spec_features.spec_quote: When that streak reaches `quit_patience` (default 2), we end the run
spec_features.evidence: config.py quit_patience: int = 2 is read in harness.py: `if gave_up_streak >= self.hcfg.quit_patience and (gave_up_this_turn or not resp.tool_calls): ... break`.
spec_features.notes: Both branches checked; breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: stop once the online score stays ≥ 0.65 for 3 consecutive turns, but only after a minimum of 8 turns
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: `if self.hcfg.early_stop_enabled and turn_idx + 1 >= self.hcfg.early_stop_min_turns: if online >= self.hcfg.early_stop_threshold: high_conf_streak += 1 else: high_conf_streak = 0; if high_conf_streak >= self.hcfg.early_stop_patience: terminal = TerminalReason.EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL; break`. Defaults 0.65/3/8 in config.py.
spec_features.notes: All three conditions enforced and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we stop: the spiral is established and extra turns just burn tokens without changing the verdict

spec_features.spec_quote: min 8 turns: give the model a genuine chance to investigate and even to escalate cleanly before we ever call it a spiral
spec_features.evidence: config.py early_stop_min_turns: int = 8 is enforced in harness.py guard `turn_idx + 1 >= self.hcfg.early_stop_min_turns` before any spiral early-stop can fire.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely gates the early-stop; part of the same mechanism as above.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We require a minimum number of turns first so we don't early-stop before the model has had a fair chance.

spec_features.spec_quote: `OnlineDetector` ... emitting a 0..1 score after each assistant turn ... drives the early-stop
spec_features.evidence: signals.py OnlineDetector.update returns a 0..1 'online' score; harness.py calls `online = detector.update(turn)` each turn and uses it for both the clean/spiral distinction and the early-stop streak comparison.
spec_features.notes: Score is computed, stamped on the turn, AND acted on (compared to threshold to break).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cheap enough to run inside the loop for early stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn cap (30)** and **completion-token cap (60k)** bound the worst case
spec_features.evidence: Turn cap: harness loop `for turn_idx in range(self.hcfg.max_turns)` (default max_turns=30) and terminal=MAX_TURNS fallback. Token cap: `if transcript.total_completion_tokens >= self.hcfg.max_total_completion_tokens: terminal = TerminalReason.MAX_TOKENS; break` (default 60_000), with total_completion_tokens accumulated in Transcript.add_turn.
spec_features.notes: Both caps are compared and break execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard cap on cumulative completion tokens for a run (defense against runaway loops).

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop is on by default and fully configurable (`--no-early-stop` to measure the un-truncated trajectory)
spec_features.evidence: config.py early_stop_enabled: bool = True; run_eval.py argparse `--no-early-stop` -> HarnessConfig(early_stop_enabled=not args.no_early_stop); harness gates the spiral early-stop on `self.hcfg.early_stop_enabled`.
spec_features.notes: Flag is wired end-to-end and branched on.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py wraps client.chat in try/except setting transcript.terminal_reason = TerminalReason.ERROR and breaking; model_client.py bounds retries with cfg.max_retries. Bounds the run on errors but is a resilience/integrity guard.
